goal.objective: Read-only BirdAI direct LM Studio smoke test. Use only the supplied bounded repository context. Return a schema-valid diagnosis, strategy, an empty files array, and summary. Do not propose, create, or modify repository files.
goal.pass_definition: The direct LM Studio backend returns a valid strict-schema response with files=[]; BirdAI reports no changed files; clean-worktree validation exits 0.

validation.command: import subprocess; r=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain'], text=True, capture_output=True, check=True); assert not r.stdout.strip(), r.stdout; print('CLEAN_WORKTREE: PASS')
